cards.title: Moss Message Pencil Voice Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch card for retelling one fictional moss-observatory moment from two paper voices: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, set out one pencil and a small paper tab, then choose pencil voice or moss voice together: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Flip the paper switch and write the same observatory moment from the voice you picked: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Tell the scene as the pencil inside the case noticing moss letters on the observatory wall: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: Tell the same scene as the moss message waiting to be read: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: The story changes when the viewpoint switch flips because the new voice notices: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: From the pencil case, I noticed the moss message had ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Reread one sentence and add a clue that proves who is telling it: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Circle pencil voice or moss voice, then write only one whisper line: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Retell one moment at home using the other paper voice: ____________________.

cards.title: Tidepool Timekeepers Eraser Order Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch card for changing the order of three pretend tidepool lab moments: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and place three pencil-case slips beside it: pencil mark, eraser puff, ruler line: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Choose one order for the slips, then write what the tidepool timekeepers do first, next, and last: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Order A begins with the pencil mark, then the eraser puff, then the ruler line: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: Order B begins with the ruler line, then the pencil mark, then the eraser puff: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: When the order switch flips, the tiny lab clock changes the story by: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: The tidepool clock clicked just as the pencil mark showed ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Check that the middle moment connects the first and last moment clearly: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Number the three slips silently before writing the next event: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Take the card home and try the other order in one new sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Sharpener Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch card for turning a plain draft sentence into a sharper ferry sentence: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, draw a tiny paper ferry, and ask the writer to move one sentence from dull to clearer: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a plain sentence on the front, flip the switch, and sharpen it on the back: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Before the ferry crossing, the sentence says something plain like: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: After the ferry crossing, the sharpened sentence adds a precise object, action, or feeling: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: The story switch works when the ferry carries one weak detail away and brings back: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: The ferry would not leave Revision River until the pencil sharpened ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Replace one vague word with a concrete pencil-case or river detail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Underline only the word you changed, then write the new word here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Show an adult the before sentence and the sharper sentence: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Question Tab Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch card for turning a pretend museum label into a useful story question: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, set out a pencil and one blank paper label, then invent a tower museum object: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write a label on the front, flip the tab, and turn the label into a question for the scene: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The museum label names an invented object with one missing fact: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The question asks what the label has not explained yet: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: The story changes when the question switch makes the character wonder: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: The label on the tower shelf made my pencil pause because ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Add one clue that points toward the answer without giving it away: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write only the strongest question first: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Ask an adult for one silly answer to your fictional label question: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Verb Dial Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch card for swapping one action verb in a fictional craft-academy scene: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card and draw a paper compass dial with pencil-case verbs such as sketch, trace, fold, shade, and label: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Pick one verb for the front, flip the dial, then rewrite the same moment with a stronger verb: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: The first craft-academy action verb is ____________________, and it makes the character seem ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: The replacement verb is ____________________, and it changes the scene by ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: When the verb switch flips, the pencil-case action changes what the character does with: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: At the compass craft table, the pencil chose to ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Choose a verb readers can picture, then remove one plain action word: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: List two possible verbs before choosing one: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Take the card home and switch one more verb in your scene: ____________________.

cards.title: Binding Day Binder Clip Ending Switch
cards.useCase: Adult-led printable switch card for testing two fictional endings on a tiny paper booklet: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Print the card, fold a small paper booklet, and use a pencil-case clip as the pretend ending switch: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Write Ending A on the front, flip the paper switch, then write Ending B on the back: ____________________.
cards.switchFrontPrompt: Front switch: Ending A ties the boardwalk booklet together by showing what changed: ____________________.
cards.switchBackPrompt: Back switch: Ending B closes the booklet with a final object, line, or choice: ____________________.
cards.storySwitchPrompt: The story switch changes the ending when the binder clip snaps onto: ____________________.
cards.firstLineSwitch: First line: On Binding Day, the last page waited for ____________________.
cards.revisionNudge: Pick the ending that answers the biggest story question, then add one final detail: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: Write the final sentence first, then decide which ending it belongs to: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: Read both endings to an adult and mark the one you would keep: ____________________.
